description: Seconds between two reads of the tenant's log while at most one check of the head is still running or the landing is in flight: the verdict is then seconds away (the landing takes ~2 s after the last check), so the slower gate-infra.poll_s would add half of it on average to a wait that ends within the next tick (AWS9). Never above gate-infra.poll_s. GATE-POLL (13/11): 0.25, under gate-infra.poll_s's 0.5.
